packages.title: Robotics Team Mentorship Program
packages.description: NSF provides structured, student-centered mentorship to developing robotics teams. Our mentorship program helps students strengthen their engineering, programming, testing, documentation, and teamwork skills while maintaining responsibility for their own competition work.
packages.adoption: Under Board review — not yet adopted
packages.note: This package is under Board review and has not been adopted. The public PDFs are available for review and planning; publication does not make them operative. Completed forms should be sent privately to NSF and must not be posted publicly.
